news.title: GCA Launcher 3.0 Preview Tour
news.summary: Explore a modernized single screen launcher by GocalSD.
news.content: We are thrilled to announce GCA Launcher 3.0 Open Beta! I will officially launch GCA v3 in 2027 with a subscription model to pro features. If you havn't been keeping an eye on my social feed, get caught up on whats new in GCA with this tour I provided on Youtube.

news.title: GCA v3 Test Video

news.content: This was one of my first visual test videos coming out to the public for GCA v3. We show off some of the homescreen interactions and Groups 2.0

title: App Drawer Issue Reported
summary: A new bug is causing havoc, click for details to see if this is affecting you!
content: Yesterday, I published an update that included what I had thought to be fixes for the launcher database. A PRUNE instance where the database would automatically fix hanging icons and ones stuck in rendering. When this instance is triggered, it causes the launcher to hang and be unresponsive. I think the only fix at the moment is wiping GCA Launcher cache and memory. A Hotfix is currently rolling out to help resolve this issue and get package session trackers back in business. Contact me if you have run into this issue and/or the next update resolves the issue!
